bio: Associate Professor of Global Health Global Health and Population, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Global Health and Population Kevin Croke is Associate Professor of Global Health in the Department of Global Health and Population at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health (HSPH), and director of the International Health Systems Program. He is also a faculty affiliate of the Center for International Development, the Harvard Data Science Initiative, the Weatherhead Center for International Affairs, and the Harvard Center for Population and Development Studies. Previously he was a researcher in the World Bank Development Impact Evaluation (DIME) group and a post-doctoral fellow at HSPH. His research focuses on the politics of health and health systems, and on evaluation of large-scale health programs and policies. BA, College of William and Mary
